## Disguise As

---


[Entity Action Types](https://origins.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types/entity_action_types/)

Applies a visual disguise to a living entity, making it appear as a different entity type to all nearby players. Works alongside the [Disguised](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=entity_conditions/disguised) condition and [Remove Disguise](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=entity_actions/remove_disguise) action.

Type ID: `sync:disguise_as`

---

### Examples

```json
{
    "type": "sync:disguise_as",
    "entity_type": "minecraft:creeper"
}
```
Makes the entity appear as a creeper.

```json
{
  "type": "sync:disguise_as",
  "entity_type": "minecraft:slime",
  "nbt": "{Size:3}"
}
```
Disguises the entity as a large slime (size 3).

```json
{
  "type": "sync:disguise_as",
  "entity_type": "minecraft:villager",
  "nbt": "{CustomName:{text:Suspicious Merchant,italic:true,color:gray}}",
  "overwrite": false
}
```
Disguises the entity as a villager with a custom nameplate, but only if not already disguised.

x-intellij-html-description:
title: Disguise As (Entity Action) date: 2024-01-07

Disguise As

Entity Action Types

Applies a visual disguise to a living entity, making it appear as a different entity type to all nearby players. Works alongside the Disguised condition and Remove Disguise action.

Type ID: sync:disguise_as

Fields

Field Type Default Description
entity_type Identifier required The entity type to disguise as
nbt NBT optional NBT data applied to the disguise entity. Used to set visual attributes such as variant, color, size, or custom name that the disguise adopts
overwrite Boolean true If false, the action does nothing when the entity already has an active disguise
before_action Entity Action optional Executed on the entity immediately before the disguise is applied
after_action Entity Action optional Executed on the entity immediately after the disguise is applied

Notes

  • Only works on LivingEntity instances server-side.
  • The disguise is cosmetic only (hitboxes, collision, and AI are unchanged).
  • Disguises are synced to all connected players, including any who join after the disguise is applied.
  • Use "overwrite": false to prevent overwriting an existing disguise (e.g. apply only if not already disguised).
  • The nbt field is applied to a client-side dummy entity of the target type. This means entity-type-specific NBT keys work (e.g. Variant for cats/foxes, Size for slimes, CustomName for the nameplate label).
  • If nbt contains a CustomName key, that name is shown on the entity's nameplate instead of the entity type's default translation key.
  • When disguising as a player, the skin of that player is used; the nbt field is ignored for player disguises.

Examples

{
    "type": "sync:disguise_as",
    "entity_type": "minecraft:creeper"
}

Makes the entity appear as a creeper.

{
  "type": "sync:disguise_as",
  "entity_type": "minecraft:slime",
  "nbt": "{Size:3}"
}

Disguises the entity as a large slime (size 3).

{
  "type": "sync:disguise_as",
  "entity_type": "minecraft:villager",
  "nbt": "{CustomName:{text:Suspicious Merchant,italic:true,color:gray}}",
  "overwrite": false
}

Disguises the entity as a villager with a custom nameplate, but only if not already disguised.
